title: Reset a workshared cloud model: remove all Revit links and delete user worksets with all worksets closed
use_when: batch-clean several workshared cloud (ACC/BIM 360) models before a relinking run, a demo or a standards reset
delete user worksets and move their elements to Workset1 without opening the worksets
remove every RevitLinkType and RevitLinkInstance from a host model
not_for: detaching or archiving models (use DetachFromCentral instead)
removing CAD imports or links (ImportInstance, CADLinkType)

environment.tool: RevitBridge 0.4.0 (local Revit API bridge, MCP) with run_csharp
environment.model: 10 workshared ACC cloud test models (generic test project)

rule: Per model, in one bridge call of at most 2-3 models (each cloud open+sync takes 15-25 s): 1) open by cloud GUIDs (ConvertCloudGUIDsToCloudPath) with WorksetConfiguration(CloseAllWorksets) and DoNotDetach; closed worksets are enough for both tasks and keep the open fast. 2) Delete all RevitLinkType and RevitLinkInstance ids in one Transaction with a failures preprocessor. 3) Collect user worksets; keep Workset1 and the shared levels/grids workset. Call WorksharingUtils.CheckoutWorksets on the worksets to delete plus Workset1 (works while they are closed); make Workset1 active. 4) In a Transaction, for each workset: DeleteWorksetSettings(MoveElementsToWorkset, Workset1), CanDeleteWorkset, then DeleteWorkset; collect failures per workset instead of aborting. 5) SynchronizeWithCentral with SaveLocalBefore and SaveLocalAfter true, RelinquishOptions(true) and a comment; skip the sync when nothing changed. 6) Close(false) in finally. Return per-model counts and timings. Check free disk space first: every cloud open fills the local collaboration cache.
validation: Re-open check: RevitLinkType and RevitLinkInstance counts are 0
User worksets are exactly Workset1 plus the shared levels/grids workset
No elements or worksets remain borrowed after sync (relinquished)
Sync comment visible in the cloud model's version history
